---
title: "The Dual-Anchor frontier"
subtitle: "Catalog C-08 (OSM Figure G.4)"
description: "How much of the count target to give up for less dominance: the Dual-Anchor solutions along lambda at J = 50, the .40 trigger, the paper's choice lambda = .30, and the hard bound .25 as a sensitivity analysis."
toc: false
---

TSMM matches the count target exactly, but at J = 50 its prior still gives
Pr(W_SB > .5) = .497: about half the time, the cluster of a randomly chosen unit holds most of
the population. The Dual-Anchor refinement adds a second anchor on the weights and weighs the
two with lambda (lambda = 1 is TSMM). Lowering lambda buys less dominance with more clusters.

```{=html}
<div id="w-da" class="dpx-host column-page"></div>
<script src="../../js/vendor/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="../../js/vendor/plot.min.js"></script>
<script src="../../js/bundles/dual-anchor-frontier.js"></script>
<script>
  (function () {
    var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search), spec = {};
    if (q.get("preset")) spec.preset = q.get("preset");
    window.__dpxDA = DPX["dual-anchor-frontier"].mountWidget(document.getElementById("w-da"), spec);
  })();
</script>
```

- **The rule.** Take the largest lambda whose prior is at or below the .40 trigger. At J = 50
  that is lambda = .30: Gamma(2.3158, 1.4204), with Pr(W_SB > .5) = .398 and E K_50 = 5.88.
  Every larger lambda (grey) leaves the trigger on.
- **The price.** Moving from TSMM (.497, E K 5.00) to lambda = .30 costs about 0.9 expected
  clusters. The hard bound .25, Gamma(5.2745, 2.3059), costs 2.5 (E K 7.49). It is reported as a
  sensitivity analysis, not as the recommended prior.
- **In the applications** the hard bound can collapse to nearly a point mass: for STAR and
  Vocabulary it puts almost all prior mass at alpha = 2 (a above 3 million), where
  Pr(W_SB > .5) is (1/2)^2 = .25 to three decimals.

For the whole J = 50 workflow on one page, see [the worked example](worked-example-j50.qmd);
to see where the trigger comes from, see [the elicitation form](elicitation.qmd).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Grid: data/released/dual_anchor_grid.json (29 values of lambda; CC BY 4.0). Hard bound:
data/precomputed/worked_example_j50.json. Applications: data/released/app_priors.json. Every
probability and expected count on this page is recomputed with dp-core.
